title: Planet Tweaks V3.0.9 NOVA TITAN - Mouse Zero-Delay, App Debloat & Custom Domain Update
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.0.9 NOVA TITAN: (1) Mouse Zero-Delay Pro Pack: Eliminates simultaneous key+click contention (AAPThreshold=0, typing palm suppression disabled) so sidejump shots and rapid clicks never get eaten while holding Spacebar or movement keys, paired with MarkC 1:1 linear curves and MouseDataQueueSize=8. (2) Dedicated App Debloat Suite: 1-click debloating for Microsoft Edge (StartupBoost=0, BackgroundMode=0, Copilot=0), Google Chrome, Brave Browser, Discord (directX hook fix, QoS DSCP 46 high priority streaming), and Spotify. (3) Razer & Logitech Third-Party Driver Bloatware Block: Prevents Windows Update from silently downloading background peripheral bloat. (4) Official Custom Domain: Deployed live to planettweaks.website with full SSL, sitemap.xml, and Google Search Console indexing. (5) UI & System Refinement: Repaired Keyboard Tweaks tab rendering and cleaned website typography.
